column4: Portable infrastructure, CI/CD and environments
column6:
Cloud-agnostic platform deployable to AWS, Google Cloud and Azure (Canadian regions: AWS ca-central-1, GCP northamerica-northeast1/2, Azure canadacentral) — Kubernetes + Helm everywhere, Terraform modules per cloud behind one interface, Postgres+PostGIS, Valkey (Redis-compatible), Kafka, Elasticsearch, object storage and KMS per provider. CI on GitHub Actions AND GitLab CI, manual trigger only until CI credits are available. Profiles per environment (local, dev, staging, prod) with a runbook each.

Phase 1. 10 stories, 60 points.

column4: Auth hardening for production
column6:
Close the production gaps in server/auth and server/bff recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md (Auth workstream).

Phase 1. 9 stories, 42 points.

column4: Production adapters for external services
column6:
Replace the local/test fakes behind every port with real adapters (storage, Stripe, KYC, registries, bank linking, DNS, calendars, commerce sync, email/SMS). Today a non-local profile fails loudly by design.

Phase 1. 12 stories, 94 points.

column4: Environment profiles and runbooks: local, dev, staging, prod
column6:
Spring profiles and env-var configuration so local runs against your own Postgres/PostGIS, Valkey and other stand-ins (MinIO, Mailpit, Kafka, Elasticsearch, stripe-mock) and every cloud environment is configured the same way. One runbook per environment listing every service, credential and secret needed, per cloud provider.

Acceptance criteria:
- docs/runbooks/{local,dev,staging,prod}.md exist
- the stack starts locally with only the documented prerequisites
- no code change is needed to switch environment or cloud — configuration only.

Refs: docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/SCREENS.md, docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
